package.name: base101_nav
package.description: Pure Nav2 stack for the base101 mobile base: planner, controller, bt_navigator, velocity smoother. SLAM/EKF live in base101_slam; the two stacks are deliberately independent (own lifecycle managers, no package dependency) — this one consumes /map and the map->odom TF from whatever publishes them. No behavior_server: recovery decisions live in the Python mission layer (robocore).
